messages:
sam: Heads-up — starting a short probing experiment on inter-zone batching heuristics. Goal: reduce p95 for EU->US spillover while keeping KV cache hit stable. experiment_id=exp-5401
anya: what's the plan? holdback window, token budgets, kernel changes?
sam: plan: 1) holdback window 30ms local-only; 2) token_budget per zone = max(16, recent_miss_rate*80); 3) if adding a request extends batch by >16 tokens, prefer local execution (no spill). kernel selection: force fp16 fused-matmul for seq>512 to lower GPU time.
ryan: how are we measuring regressions? list of metrics?
sam: metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, kv_cache_hit, cold_start_rate, tokens/sec, kernel_efficiency; traces: /traces/exp-5401/*; will run 2h canary in eu-west-1 then eu-central-1
infra-bot: deploy: batcher-service v2.3-canary rolled to eu-west-1 :rocket: (sha: c3f9d1a)
anya: quick check on canary results — kv_cache_hit down ~2.4% vs baseline, p95 improved 8%, p99 unchanged. traces show extra cross-zone cold_lookup on 7% of requests.
sam: noted. hypothesis: holdback policy causes slightly larger local batches that miss local KV TTL and then spill; adjust spill_threshold from 0.6 -> 0.45 and lower token_budget floor from 16 -> 12. try config:
```
{"holdback_ms":30, "spill_threshold":0.45, "token_budget_min":12, "affinity_weight":0.85}
```
ryan: also try kernel knob: small-fft for seq<128 to reduce kernel launch overhead. observed p50 12ms -> 10ms in microbench.
anya: profiler: KV lookup median up ~3ms on cross-zone paths. increasing batch window >50ms doesn't help because reordering increases miss amplification. :thinking:
sam: ok let's try combined tweak: spill_threshold 0.45 + affinity_weight 0.85 + kernel rules. If p99 rises >5% or kv_cache_hit drops >1% we rollback automatically.
ryan: I'll start A/B (2h) now, collect traces and telemetry, will annotate with request samples and kernel selection logs. @infra-bot create experiment record
infra-bot: experiment created: /experiments/5401 — canary config pinned, auto-rollback hooks set
anya: thanks — I'll monitor cache heatmaps and KV TTL metrics, will ping if we see evictions spike
sam: great. summarize results after 2h and decide next steps.
